subject: Mini pilot: hosted eval — sandbox endpoints & sustained load profile
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa@brightcart.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom@brightcart.com>, procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Sat, 04 Nov 2028 16:02:00 -0500
Subject: Mini pilot: hosted eval — sandbox endpoints & sustained load profile

Hi Alyssa — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get a hosted mini-pilot running next week:

Recap of requirements you shared:
- Primary feature: real-time product-recommendation model (inference ~512 tokens average)
- Target latency: 150–250ms p95 for single-turn requests
- Expected pilot traffic: sustained ~20–30 RPS during business hours, occasional bursts to ~70 RPS
- Data residency: US-only (BrightCart requires US region)
- Security: SOC2 + standard DPIA questions; procurement and Tom will own legal/security review

Proposed hosted mini-pilot (two-week):
1) Sandbox endpoints (isolated hosted project) — we’ll provision 2 endpoints: "rec-endpoint" (prod-like), "staging-rec" (load tests).
2) Rate envelope: we'll start with 25 RPS sustained per endpoint and a burst buffer. If you confirm traffic profile we can request a temporary uplift.
3) Sample load + test vectors — please upload a small sample set (1000 requests) so we can sanity-check latency and token counts. Attached is a sample_load_profile.csv you can use as a template.
4) Success metrics: p95 < 250ms, error rate < 0.5%, qualitative review of output quality.

Questions / asks for you now:
- Can you confirm the sustained RPS and burst cadence (e.g., 70 RPS bursts length)?
- Are there any privacy obligations beyond SOC2 (e.g., specific retention windows)?
- Who on your side will own getting the sample vectors to our sandbox?

Next steps I can take this afternoon:
- Open sandbox project and share endpoints (I’ll loop in Marissa for provisioning)
- Submit temporary rate uplift request if you confirm the burst pattern
- Share onboarding checklist and a brief Ops call slot for Tuesday (30 min)

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: sample_load_profile.csv (CSV template)
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa@brightcart.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom@brightcart.com>, procurement@brightcart.com
Date: Sat, 04 Nov 2028 19:11:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Mini pilot: hosted eval — sandbox endpoints & sustained load profile

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear recap and plan. A few answers and notes from our side:

- Sustained RPS: 25 RPS is a good starting point. Typical business hours traffic is concentrated 10:00–16:00 ET. Bursts to 70 RPS usually last 3–7 minutes when promotions run.
- Retention: we redact PII before sending, but legal wants a confirmation that Redwood will not store raw payloads longer than 24 hours for the pilot.
- Sample vectors: I’ll have my ML engineer, Priya Shah, upload the 1k test vectors by Monday. (Priya in a separate thread; I’ll CC her once she’s ready.)

Can you confirm the expected default rate limits per endpoint and whether we need to request a special uplift for the 70 RPS bursts? Also please flag any additional security evidence we should expect to provide for the SOC2 checklist.

I’m fine with Tuesday for a 30-min ops call — between 11:00–13:00 ET works best.

Thanks,
Alyssa Turner
Head of AI Products, BrightCart

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Turner <alyssa@brightcart.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Nov 2028 08:03:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Mini pilot: hosted eval — sandbox endpoints & sustained load profile

Marissa / Ben — looping you both in to help provision a hosted sandbox for BrightCart and advise on default rate limits / uplift process. Key asks from Alyssa:
- Region: US-only
- Sustained RPS: 25 (per endpoint), burst up to 70 RPS for short windows (3–7 minutes)
- Retention: they want confirmation that pilot payloads are retained <=24h

Can you: 
1) Provision an isolated sandbox project (BrightCart-BR-5482) with two endpoints: rec-endpoint, staging-rec
2) Share the default per-endpoint rate limit and what we can approve as a temporary uplift for the two-week pilot
3) Prepare the onboarding checklist and sandbox endpoint matrix so I can send to Alyssa

I’ve attached the sample_load_profile.csv Alyssa will use. I’ll book the 11:30 ET Tuesday slot tentatively.

Thanks — Jordan
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Turner <alyssa@brightcart.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Mini pilot: hosted eval — sandbox endpoints & sustained load profile

Thanks for the context — happy to own provisioning and the uplift workflow. Quick answers and attached artifacts: 

- Sandbox provisioning: I can create the BrightCart-BR-5482 project in US-east-1 and spin up both endpoints by EOD today.
- Default limits: 10 RPS per endpoint by default on sandboxes. For pilots we typically approve 25 RPS per endpoint without infra changes. For sustained 25 RPS and short 70 RPS bursts, we recommend:
  * Approve temporary uplift to 80 RPS global burst across the project (automated throttle at 90 RPS fallback).
  * Monitor for token distribution — if average tokenization exceeds 700 tokens, we should throttle or add an extra replica.
- Data retention: We can set pilot project logs/payload retention to 24 hours and confirm that to BrightCart.

Attached: sandbox_endpoint_matrix.yaml (endpoints, ports, hostnames, auth tokens) and pilot_onboarding_checklist.pdf (ops steps and SLA expectations).

Next actions from ops:
1) I’ll provision the endpoints and post the console link to the thread.
2) Ben — can you pre-approve an uplift for BRIGHT-5482 to 80 RPS burst on the ops side? I’ll include a temporary expiry date (two weeks) in the request.
3) Jordan — please confirm the Tuesday 11:30 ET call and share any test vectors once they’re available.

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Customer Onboarding Ops
Redwood Inference

- Meeting: booked Tuesday 11:30 ET — please tell me if 11:00–11:30 would be better. I’ll send a calendar invite with the sandbox links once Marissa confirms provisioning.
